target_revision: UCTP envelope 2 / connect/2; frozen Gate 6 contract overlays
rules: This file is the planning inventory, not a completed clause-level audit or test result.
G6-002 expands every normative clause and resolves spec/code contradictions.
Every existing envelope family and mandatory applicable requirement is in scope.
Unknown or not-implemented responses do not pass a mandatory behavior.
Breaking Connect pre-alpha API/SDK/schema changes are allowed; no legacy compatibility layer is required.
Optional or reserved classification requires a cited source rule or reviewed specification decision.

normative_areas.title: Envelope and version contract
normative_areas.scope: IDs, scope/correlation, timestamp meaning, unknown data, bounds and version refusal.

normative_areas.title: Transport framing
normative_areas.scope: QUIC reliable streams/datagrams, HTTP3/WT, WSS/WebRTC bindings, byte framing and limits.

normative_areas.title: Identity and authentication
normative_areas.scope: Principal/device/participant binding, assurance, supported signing, refresh/revocation and tenant scope.

normative_areas.title: Conversation lifetime
normative_areas.scope: Persistence, closure policy, metadata, membership and authorized listing.

normative_areas.title: Session boundaries
normative_areas.scope: Active/ended transitions, reconnect grace, concurrent participants and terminal races.

normative_areas.title: Connection and replacement
normative_areas.scope: Ownership, readiness, negotiation, hold/mute, retained/replaced IDs and cancellation.

normative_areas.title: Streams and multiparty
normative_areas.scope: Capabilities, fanout/subscriptions, heterogeneous streams, media graph and flow control.

normative_areas.title: Messaging and records
normative_areas.scope: Recipients, typed bytes, replies, receipts, history pagination, files and visibility.

normative_areas.title: Capability negotiation
normative_areas.scope: Intersection, unsupported combinations, re-advertisement and transcoding policy.

normative_areas.title: Signaling and observations
normative_areas.scope: DTMF and quality schema, scope, source and meaningful observed values.

normative_areas.title: vCon and retention
normative_areas.scope: Required outcome records, schema linkage, capture policy, retrieval, redaction and deletion.

normative_areas.title: Errors and retry
normative_areas.scope: Anti-replay versus operation retry, accepted/completed distinction, conflicts and unknown outcomes.

normative_areas.title: Gateway boundary
normative_areas.scope: SIP/WebRTC/provider mapping, addressed endpoints, incoming routing and actual media proof.

normative_areas.title: Extension and privacy rules
normative_areas.scope: Audience-safe replay/context, subscriptions, action observations and extension negotiation.

normative_areas.title: Operating limits
normative_areas.scope: Rate/backpressure limits, queues, retention windows, teardown, workload and resources.

proposed_additions.title: Membership, scoped role and historical access
proposed_additions.scope: Clarify conversation membership versus live session presence and implement explicit changes.

proposed_additions.title: Endpoint provisioning and discovery
proposed_additions.scope: Standardize shared discovery/capability semantics; define trusted provisioning in an explicit application/admin profile.

proposed_additions.title: Private consultation
proposed_additions.scope: Specify isolated media audience, held remote treatment, context and cancellation.

proposed_additions.title: Participant handoff
proposed_additions.scope: Specify generic readiness-gated role/speaking transfer and outgoing disposition.

proposed_additions.title: Device replacement
proposed_additions.scope: Specify same-participant endpoint replacement and confirmation with stable retained IDs.

proposed_additions.title: Durable operation status and reconciliation
proposed_additions.scope: Separate logical operation IDs from envelope anti-replay; define observable progress and uncertainty.

proposed_additions.title: Snapshots and resumable events
proposed_additions.scope: Specify authoritative cursor recovery, authorization, expiry and backpressure.

proposed_additions.title: Audience-safe records and context
proposed_additions.scope: Specify visibility of receipts/history/files/transcripts/vCon and bounded AI projections.

proposed_additions.title: Agent observations and action requests
proposed_additions.scope: Normalize attributed observations and requests without treating model intent as authority.
